dct_description_sm:
The Fire Ban Zones layer indicates two zones within the City of Kingston where different open-air burn restrictions apply, as determined by Kingston Fire & Rescue. This service is a resource for you to learn what constitutes open-air fires, where and how it is permitted, what zone you live in, and if a burn ban is in effect in your area. 

For more information, please  contact Fire Communications Centre, 613-548-4001 ext. 0.
